6c735c617f1287825ac0.en: A main clause makes sense on its own. A subordinate clause depends on a main clause.
6c735c617f1287825ac0.id: Induk kalimat (main clause) sudah jelas artinya walau berdiri sendiri. Anak kalimat (subordinate clause) bergantung pada induk kalimat.

3024c25d209b2a6e38ee.en: Subordinate clauses often begin with words such as because, although, when and who.
3024c25d209b2a6e38ee.id: Anak kalimat sering dimulai dengan kata seperti because, although, when, dan who.

7d07e16c5102aec21a69.en: Word classes: nouns name, verbs show actions or states, adjectives describe nouns, adverbs describe verbs and adjectives, prepositions show position or time, conjunctions join.
7d07e16c5102aec21a69.id: Jenis kata (word classes): noun menyebut nama, verb menunjukkan perbuatan atau keadaan, adjective menjelaskan noun, adverb menjelaskan verb dan adjective, preposition menunjukkan tempat atau waktu, conjunction menyambung.

dbccf913de9ee0aec12b.en: Short sentences can build tension or speed. Long sentences can slow the pace and create calm.
dbccf913de9ee0aec12b.id: Kalimat pendek bisa menimbulkan rasa tegang atau membuat cerita terasa cepat. Kalimat panjang bisa memperlambat cerita dan menimbulkan rasa tenang.

1e94bc395ef489089228.en: Because the sun was out depends on a main clause, so it is a subordinate clause.
1e94bc395ef489089228.id: Because the sun was out bergantung pada induk kalimat (main clause), jadi itu adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

ecd8a7fc62a21c30e5ff.en: A main clause has a subject and a verb and makes sense by itself. The others need another clause.
ecd8a7fc62a21c30e5ff.id: Induk kalimat (main clause) punya subjek dan kata kerja, dan artinya jelas walau berdiri sendiri. Yang lainnya memerlukan klausa lain.

ec1ec03995830a27ddd6.en: Joko cycled to school makes sense on its own. Although it was raining depends on it.
ec1ec03995830a27ddd6.id: Joko cycled to school sudah jelas artinya walau berdiri sendiri. Although it was raining bergantung padanya.

fed26b8d05579058f455.en: Because begins the subordinate clause, which gives the reason.
fed26b8d05579058f455.id: Because memulai anak kalimat (subordinate clause), yang memberikan alasan.

2a5c8566e1e163776fb9.en: Three clauses depend on the main clause Leo came out: one about time, one about who, and one giving a reason.
2a5c8566e1e163776fb9.id: Tiga klausa bergantung pada induk kalimat Leo came out: satu tentang waktu, satu tentang siapa, dan satu memberi alasan.

8939fc1b6c287da297a4.en: The first three can stand alone. The last three begin with a conjunction and need a main clause.
8939fc1b6c287da297a4.id: Tiga yang pertama bisa berdiri sendiri. Tiga yang terakhir dimulai dengan kata hubung (conjunction) dan memerlukan induk kalimat.

ef9536607a684aff21c1.en: A short sentence after long ones stands out. It can create tension or surprise.
ef9536607a684aff21c1.id: Kalimat pendek setelah kalimat-kalimat panjang terasa menonjol. Kalimat itu bisa menimbulkan rasa tegang atau terkejut.

c4bb7a276ebfd859e7fd.en: The long sentence and gentle verbs make the pace slow and the mood calm.
c4bb7a276ebfd859e7fd.id: Kalimat yang panjang dan kata kerja yang lembut membuat iramanya lambat dan suasananya tenang.

a4aacfefeb718863cf15.en: A string of short, sharp sentences gives the feeling of speed and panic.
a4aacfefeb718863cf15.id: Deretan kalimat yang pendek dan tajam memberi rasa cepat dan panik.

5397769984bebd18548a.en: Harbour and teacher are nouns, explore and decide are verbs, golden and ancient are adjectives, and quietly and swiftly are adverbs.
5397769984bebd18548a.id: Harbour dan teacher adalah kata benda (noun), explore dan decide adalah kata kerja (verb), golden dan ancient adalah kata sifat (adjective), dan quietly dan swiftly adalah kata keterangan (adverb).

91b962674696e2feb384.en: Quickly tells how the frog leapt, so it is an adverb.
91b962674696e2feb384.id: Quickly memberi tahu bagaimana katak itu melompat, jadi itu kata keterangan (adverb).

fb9cc8431c25ca981d64.en: In Please light the candle, light is the action word, so it is a verb.
fb9cc8431c25ca981d64.id: Pada Please light the candle, light menyebut perbuatan, jadi itu kata kerja (verb).

d24574415cab7d3889b8.en: Each class has a job: nouns name, verbs act, adjectives describe nouns, adverbs often describe verbs, conjunctions join and prepositions show position.
d24574415cab7d3889b8.id: Setiap jenis kata punya tugas: noun memberi nama, verb menyebut perbuatan, adjective menerangkan noun, adverb sering menerangkan verb, conjunction menggabungkan, dan preposition menunjukkan letak.

5c7b76c769791d6c5a4a.en: Under shows where the cat hid in relation to the bed, so it is a preposition.
5c7b76c769791d6c5a4a.id: Under menunjukkan letak persembunyian kucing itu terhadap tempat tidur, jadi itu kata depan (preposition).

2fb39f75d3e87809a46f.en: They replaces Amara and Tom, so it is a pronoun.
2fb39f75d3e87809a46f.id: They menggantikan Amara dan Tom, jadi itu kata ganti (pronoun).

ee707ab5db6a8ef7432c.en: Although she was tired is the subordinate clause. Putri finished her essay is the main clause.
ee707ab5db6a8ef7432c.id: Although she was tired adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause). Putri finished her essay adalah induk kalimat (main clause).

5ca672fc8e92f6182835.en: Dad decided to wait at the cafe can stand alone. The other two depend on it.
5ca672fc8e92f6182835.id: Dad decided to wait at the cafe bisa berdiri sendiri. Dua bagian lainnya bergantung padanya.

f18c7946d936dfe79c2c.en: The clause depends on the main clause and tells us more about Hadi. It is a subordinate (relative) clause.
f18c7946d936dfe79c2c.id: Klausa itu bergantung pada induk kalimat dan menambah keterangan tentang Hadi. Itu disebut anak kalimat, atau subordinate (relative) clause.
